item.text: {"ticker":"JNJ","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. The MCP FCFF valuation for Johnson & Johnson returns an estimated value per share of $158.22 versus a market price of $234.34. Growth uses a THREE_STAGE, 15-year projection: revenue growth is 12.62% for years 2-5 and fades to 4.6% terminal growth. Margins start near 29.0% and converge to 24.81%, above the industry comparison base of 20.42%. Reinvestment is modeled through sales-to-capital of 1.47x in years 1-5 and 1.01x in years 6-10, with terminal reinvestment of 47.76%. Cost of capital starts at 9.5% and moves to a 9.63% terminal rate, using a 4.6% risk-free rate and Damodaran mature-market ERP plus country risk premium data dated 2026-04-01. Terminal value is $786.70B, with present value of terminal value at $200.53B, a large share of the $413.70B operating asset value. Data caveats: rates are shown in percent, sales-to-capital is a multiple, Yahoo Finance data may be missing or stale, and the model upgraded to THREE_STAGE because market price and modeled value diverged materially in the first-pass baseline."}
